notes: A Lignes d'Azur ticket costs 1.50 EUR (bus and tram), or 5 EUR for a day pass; TER trains run along the coast (Monaco 20 min, Cannes 30 min). Tram 2 goes to the airport.

Winter is sunny at 12-15°C (Europe's winter retreat). February brings the Nice Carnival and the Menton Lemon Festival. April-May and October are ideal, and the sea is warm enough for swimming until October.
Socca 4 EUR, pan bagnat 6, salade niçoise 15, restaurants 25-40, museums 10 (Nice museum pass 15 EUR/3 days); round up the bill for a tip.
Monaco's casino is open to tourists before 14:00 and has an evening dress code; go to Èze in the morning; book ahead for La Colombe d'Or, and remember La Merenda has no phone.
Watch for pickpockets on tram 1 and at Cours Saleya; don't leave belongings on the beaches.
Rosé de Provence, pastis, tarte tropézienne; Nice's cuisine blends Italian and Provençal.

stops.name: Cours Saleya Market
stops.tips: Flower and food market (antiques on Mondays); try socca (chickpea pancake) at the Chez Thérésa stand, and pan bagnat.

stops.name: Vieux Nice Streets
stops.tips: Ochre-coloured Italianate streets; Sainte-Réparate cathedral, Fenocchio ice cream (100 flavours).

stops.name: Colline du Château
stops.tips: Castle hill with a waterfall and views over the Baie des Anges; free lift (Bellanda tower).

stops.name: Chez Pipo
stops.tips: Wood-fired socca since 1923; next to Port Lympia, expect a queue.

stops.name: Promenade des Anglais
stops.tips: A winter stroll along the promenade and its blue chairs; sunny 15°C.

backups.name: Fenocchio Glacier
backups.tips: Lavender, olive and beer ice cream; on Place Rossetti.

backups.name: Palais Lascaris
backups.tips: Baroque palace with a collection of musical instruments; in Vieux Nice.

stops.name: Musée National Marc Chagall
stops.tips: The 17 paintings of the Biblical Message and stained glass; in Cimiez, bus 15, closed Tuesdays.

stops.name: Musée Matisse
stops.tips: Red Genoese villa; Matisse's cut-outs, olive-grove park (Roman arena).

stops.name: Café Matisse Cimiez
stops.tips: Café in the museum park; salade niçoise.

stops.name: Place Masséna
stops.tips: Red-paved square with statues of the 7 continents (lit up at night); by tram.

stops.name: Promenade du Paillon
stops.tips: Park with a water mirror; walk from Masséna to MAMAC.

backups.name: MAMAC
backups.tips: Modern art (Klein, Niki de Saint Phalle); free rooftop terrace.

backups.name: Lou Pilha Leva Vieux Nice
backups.tips: Socca, pissaladière and beignets eaten standing up.

stops.name: Èze Village
stops.tips: Bus 82/112 (1.50 EUR) or train to Èze-sur-Mer; 1 hour climb up the Nietzsche Path. Medieval eagle's-nest village with a Fragonard perfume factory.

stops.name: Monte-Carlo Casino
stops.tips: Belle Époque casino (entry 19 EUR, visit before 14:00); Café de Paris, Ferraris.

stops.name: Monaco-Ville Rock and Prince's Palace
stops.tips: The old town on the Rock; changing of the guard at 11:55, Cathedral (Grace Kelly's tomb).

stops.name: Marché de la Condamine
stops.tips: Monaco's market food hall; barbagiuan and socca, the affordable side of Monaco.

stops.name: Oceanographic Museum
stops.tips: Cousteau's aquarium on the cliff edge; rooftop views.

backups.name: Jardin Exotique de Monaco
backups.tips: Monaco's cactus garden and cave; an alternative to the aquarium.

backups.name: Le Nid d'Aigle Èze
backups.tips: Terrace restaurant at the top of the village.

stops.name: Villefranche-sur-Mer
stops.tips: 7 minutes by train; colourful harbour, Cocteau's Saint-Pierre chapel, Rue Obscure tunnel.

stops.name: Plage des Marinières
stops.tips: Winter walk along the bay.

stops.name: Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild
stops.tips: Pink villa with 9 themed gardens; musical fountains every 20 minutes, tea room.

stops.name: Sentier du Littoral Cap Ferrat
stops.tips: Coastal path around the peninsula; Saint-Jean harbour, Paloma beach.

stops.name: Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat Harbour
stops.tips: Harbour café; a billionaires' village among the Rothschild villas.

backups.name: Villa Kérylos Beaulieu
backups.tips: Replica of a Greek villa on the seafront; an alternative to Ephrussi.

stops.name: Marché Provençal Antibes
stops.tips: 25 minutes by train; covered Provençal market, olives and tapenade.

stops.name: Musée Picasso Antibes
stops.tips: Picasso's 1946 studio in the Grimaldi castle; sculptures on the sea terrace.

stops.name: Cannes La Croisette
stops.tips: 10 minutes by train; handprints at the Palais des Festivals, palm trees.

stops.name: Le Suquet Cannes
stops.tips: Old town hill; lunch near Marché Forville with views over the harbour.

stops.name: Île Sainte-Marguerite
stops.tips: Quiet in winter; forest walk.

stops.name: Saint-Paul-de-Vence
stops.tips: Train to Cagnes plus bus 655; walled artists' village, Chagall's grave, galleries, pétanque at Café de la Place.

stops.name: Fondation Maeght
stops.tips: Miró labyrinth, Giacometti courtyard, Chagall mosaic; one of Europe's finest modern art foundations.

stops.name: La Colombe d'Or
stops.tips: The inn where Picasso and Matisse left paintings in exchange for meals; terrace (reservation needed) or café outside meal service.

stops.name: Chapelle du Rosaire Vence
stops.tips: The chapel Matisse called his masterpiece; check its afternoon opening hours.

stops.name: Vence Old Town
stops.tips: Medieval town; Chagall mosaic in the cathedral, then the bus back.

backups.name: Le Tilleul Saint-Paul
backups.tips: Terrace under a linden tree; a good alternative to the Colombe.

backups.name: Renoir Museum Cagnes
backups.tips: Renoir's last home, set in an olive grove; an alternative to Vence.

days.theme: Seaside morning and a gentle farewell

stops.name: Plage Beau Rivage Morning Swim
stops.tips: Winter run along the promenade.

stops.name: Marché de la Libération
stops.tips: The locals' market (Gare du Sud); pissaladière and cheese.

stops.name: Confiserie Florian
stops.tips: Crystallised flowers and fruit sweets; by the harbour, good for souvenirs.

stops.name: La Merenda
stops.tips: A Niçoise legend with 12 tables, no phone and no cards; daube and stockfish, a farewell meal.

stops.name: Tram 2 to the Airport
stops.tips: 25 minutes to the airport on tram 2; farewell.

backups.name: Le Safari Cours Saleya
backups.tips: Niçoise classics on the market terrace.

backups.name: Musée Masséna
backups.tips: Belle Époque villa and the history of Nice; on the Promenade.
